# WebScraping.AI

WebScraping.AI provides an API for web scraping with features like Chrome JS rendering, rotating proxies, and HTML parsing.

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/webscraping-ai/.

## Actions

- **Get account usage and quota** (read-only): Retrieve account api call quota and usage.
- **Get Rendered HTML** (read-only): Retrieve fully rendered html of a webpage.
- **Get Text** (read-only): Retrieve raw text content from a specified web page.
- **Retrieve HTML Content** (read-only): Retrieve html content of a web page.
